correctness.rationale: For x>0 the map is mx-floor((2m-1)x/2), with sign preserved; oddness handles x<0. Above 2 the remainder bound contracts the excess by at least a factor 1/2 as long as the orbit stays above 2, and the first branch above 2 maps sufficiently near points below 2. The two strips inside (0,2) outside the core map by expanding the distance from 0 or 2 until core entry. On the closed core, the endpoints of each cell image are between the core endpoints, including the actual value at each even-indexed jump. Even/odd cells have successor intervals starting at r and r+m. Each cell can reach 2m-2 in at most two steps, and this hub can reach 2 by decreasing even indices. From 2 it reaches 1 through m, then the remainder of the left half via smaller even predecessors. The hub reaches its reflected hub via 2m-3, including m=2, and reflection covers the right half. The hub self-loop makes the graph primitive. Because affine inverse branches have constant Jacobian 1/m, uniform within-cell densities give exactly the Markov conditional laws even after specifying a finite past itinerary. Shrinking cylinders make this partition generating. The positive stationary density is equivalent to core Lebesgue; mixing and Birkhoff give uniqueness among ACIPs and physicality, with nonsingular finite entry extending the a.e. statement to the full sign half-line. Entropy is log(m) and the derivative product is m^n off the null set of boundary preimages. The sole incoming edge to cell 1 forces pi_1=pi_2/m. Independent exact interval pushforward and moment integration checked m=2 (variance 1/9); replay: python3 /workspace/branches/independent_checks.py 3. The original verifier was inspected, not executed; neither finite check establishes the universal or a.e. claims.

value.rationale: The uniform-in-m trapping and communication result resolves whether the linear remainder construction has a single statistical regime and whether its expanding branches yield a uniform physical density. The answer is two sign-separated mixing regimes with strictly nonuniform density and exact rational cell weights. This is useful structure for the published model, not a conclusion about digital randomness, finite precision or security.
